# Brightmark

> > Brightmark reimagines waste through circular economy solutions, transforming organic waste and plastics into renewable energy and sustainable materials.

Brightmark operates Organics Circularity Centers using anaerobic digestion technology to convert organic waste into Renewable Natural Gas (RNG), while also developing plastics renewal technologies and educational initiatives like the Changing the Tide marine science curriculum.

## Key Topics

- Renewable Natural Gas (RNG)
- Anaerobic Digestion
- Circularity Centers
- Organic Waste Conversion
- Methane Capture
- Circular Economy
- Plastics Renewal
- Dairy Partnerships
- Emissions Reduction
- Waste-to-Energy
- Environmental Innovation
- Sustainability Solutions
- Rochester Circularity Center
- Marine Science Education

- [Changing the Tide: Marine Science Curriculum | Brightmark](https://www.brightmark.com/changing-the-tide/curriculum): Free K-12 marine science curriculum on plastic pollution with partners
